name: CC0 Library
description: Free CC0 models, textures and skies from Poly Haven and ambientCG, fetched into your game with their licence recorded. No account or credits.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the CC0 libraries: Poly Haven's models, textures and HDRI skies, and ambientCG's materials. Free, no account. Returns each result's source and id (what cc0__fetch takes), its name, authors, page, and for a model its polycount and size in millimetres. kind is model, texture or hdri (default texture); source narrows to polyhaven or ambientcg; limit is 1-24 (default 8). Search before generating a common prop, surface or sky.

query.description: Words to look for in the name, tags and categories, for example 'wooden crate' or 'brick wall'.

source.description: polyhaven or ambientcg; left out, both where they offer the kind.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one CC0 asset into this game's assets/cc0/<job>/ folder. Studio downloads it, checks its size and digests and records it as CC0-1.0 with its source; you never download anything yourself. A Poly Haven model arrives as one self-contained GLB (its maps embedded); a texture as its maps (default diff, nor_gl and arm on Poly Haven; diff, nor_gl, rough, ao and metal on ambientCG); an HDRI as one .hdr. source is polyhaven, ambientcg or curated (a hand-picked, sha256-pinned pack by its id). resolution is 1k, 2k or 4k (default 1k): fetch the size it is seen at, phones 1k. maps names extra or different texture maps, comma-separated: diff, nor_gl, nor_dx, arm, rough, ao, metal, disp. Fetching the same asset and resolution again lands in the same folder.

id.description: The id cc0__search returned, for example wooden_crate_01 or Bricks076C.

tools.name: terrain-layer
tools.description: Pack a texture scan already in this game (a cc0__fetch folder, or maps you name) into the two textures a Rust TerrainLayer::textured(albedo, data, tile) reads: <name>_albedo.png (colour, height in alpha) and <name>_data.png (OpenGL normal x and y, roughness, occlusion) under assets/terrain/. Local only: no download, no credits. folder is a game-relative folder whose maps are found by name (Poly Haven diff, nor_gl, nor_dx, rough, arm, ao, disp; ambientCG Color, NormalGL, NormalDX, Roughness, AmbientOcclusion, Displacement); diff, nor_gl, nor_dx, rough, arm, ao and disp name a map's game-relative path instead. A colour map is required; a missing role packs its neutral value and the answer lists it. Fetch the scan with disp for a height blend. Returns the paths TerrainLayer::textured takes, the Rust line and the genex.toml [[texture]] rows. Paths must stay inside the game; out must be under assets/.

name.description: The layer's file name stem, for example snow: letters, digits, _ and -.

folder.description: A game-relative folder of maps, for example the assets/cc0/<job> cc0__fetch answered.

nor_dx.description: A DirectX normal map's path (its green is flipped).

arm.description: An ARM or ORM map's path (occlusion red, roughness green).

out.description: The output folder under assets/ (default assets/terrain).

size.description: The longest output side: a power of two from 256 to 4096 (default 2048); the colour map's own size when smaller.

normalize_height.description: Stretch the height over its own range (default true).

tile.description: Metres per repeat, for the Rust line (default 4).

skills.name: cc0-library
skills.text: Free CC0 assets come from the CC0 Library: cc0__search finds Poly Haven models, textures and HDRI skies and ambientCG materials; cc0__fetch puts one into assets/cc0/<job>/ and records it as CC0-1.0 in the asset lock. Never download assets yourself or write licence rows by hand. Prefer a CC0 asset to generating a common prop, surface or sky. Fetch at the size it is seen at (1k by default, 1k on phones). A Poly Haven model arrives as one self-contained GLB: load the returned path. A texture arrives as maps whose role (diff colour, nor_gl normal, arm occlusion/roughness/metalness) says how to sample it. Search results from Poly Haven carry the line Powered by Poly Haven; keep it next to them when you show them to the person.

skills.name: cc0-library-rust
skills.text: Free CC0 assets come from the CC0 Library: cc0__search finds Poly Haven models, textures and HDRI skies and ambientCG materials; cc0__fetch puts one into assets/cc0/<job>/ and records it as CC0-1.0 in genex-assets.lock. Never download assets yourself or write lock rows by hand. Prefer a CC0 asset to generating a common prop, surface or sky. Fetch at the size it is seen at (1k by default, 1k on phones). A Poly Haven model arrives as one self-contained GLB: load it in on_reset with gfx.assets().model("cc0/<job>/<name>.glb"), the returned path without its leading assets/, and verify state().__render.missingModels stays absent. A texture arrives as maps whose role (diff colour, nor_gl normal, arm occlusion/roughness/metalness) decides its usage at import; declare a [[texture]] row only for a v2-material loose map. For a Terrain ground, cc0__fetch a texture (add disp to maps for the height blend), then cc0__terrain-layer on its folder, then pass the paths it answers to TerrainLayer::textured. Search results from Poly Haven carry the line Powered by Poly Haven; keep it next to them when you show them to the person.
